about: All units of the 21 Grade 6-8 textbooks, for tracking Notes progress. Generated by tools/make_notes_manifest.py - do not edit by hand.
notes: citizenship_7: The contents list two sub-units numbered 1.3 (Qualities of Good Friendship, Goal Setting); kept as printed.
tigrigna_6: The printed contents skip the number of unit 4 (ማይ, p. 54) and then number units 4-7 as 4-7 while their sub-units are 5.x-8.x. Here the units are renumbered 1-8 in book order (ማይ = 4).

tigrigna_7: The .txt extraction garbles some Ge'ez letters (E, I, O appear in place of Ge'ez characters). Titles were fixed by hand from the PDF where the garbling is obvious; check the rest against the PDF.
